summary: See the world through the eyes of a cat - your virtual pet friend!
description:
Live the dream of every pet owner! See the world through the eyes of a cat! Are you prepared for all the surprises that come with being an adorable feline? Make difficult choices and new friends along the way. Take care of your cat and make his life as perfect as you’d wish for yourself!
Cat Life allows you to experience life as a cat, with full control over your feline companion. You will have the opportunity to see the world through your cat's eyes, and enjoy all the perks and pitfalls of cat life.
As you start the game, you will create your own cat, choosing its appearance and personality. Once you've created your cat, you can start exploring the world around you. The game is set in a virtual world with realistic environments, including parks, neighborhoods, and homes.

Your cat will need affection to thrive, so you'll need to take care of your furry friend!  The game offers a variety of challenges and opportunities for your cat to explore. Interact with other cats in the neighborhood and make friends, play with humans, and more. Take your cat on walks, play games with it, and buy new toys and accessories to keep it entertained.
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter different challenges and obstacles. You'll need to make difficult choices. You'll also encounter other cats and you'll need to navigate these interactions to ensure your cat's safety.
Whether you're a seasoned cat owner or just curious about what life is like as a feline, this game has something for everyone. Start your life as a cat now!

IGRS rating: 13+
